result.instructions: Tools for Koyeb, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our Koyeb services are not running right now?"; "Show me the last 100 error lines from the production API service."; "Redeploy the web service from commit abc1234 and tell me when it is live.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Koyeb data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run koyeb_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run koyeb_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run koyeb_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. koyeb_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: koyeb_get_account
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Return the Koyeb user that owns the API key. Cheapest check that the key works. GET /v1/account/profile.

tools.name: koyeb_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the Koyeb regions a service can run in. GET /v1/catalog/regions.

tools.name: koyeb_list_instance_types
tools.title: List instance types
tools.description: List the instance types (CPU, memory, GPU, pricing) a service can use. GET /v1/catalog/instances.

tools.name: koyeb_get_usage
tools.title: Get organization usage
tools.description: Return the organization's usage totals for a time window. GET /v1/usages.

tools.name: koyeb_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List recent account activity (deploys, pauses, scaling and other events). GET /v1/activities.

types.description: Filter by one or more activity types.

tools.name: koyeb_list_apps
tools.title: List apps
tools.description: List the apps in the organization, with their domains. Good first call. GET /v1/apps.

tools.name: koyeb_get_app
tools.title: Get app
tools.description: Return one app by id. GET /v1/apps/{id}.

tools.name: koyeb_pause_app
tools.title: Pause app
tools.description: PAUSE an app: stops all its services and their instances, so its public URLs stop serving traffic. POST /v1/apps/{id}/pause.

tools.name: koyeb_resume_app
tools.title: Resume app
tools.description: RESUME a paused app so its services start again. POST /v1/apps/{id}/resume.

tools.name: koyeb_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List services (web, worker, sandbox, database and others) with status, region and definition. Filter by app. GET /v1/services.

types.description: Filter by one or more service types.

statuses.description: Filter by one or more service statuses.

regions.description: Filter by one or more regions (for example fra, was).

tools.name: koyeb_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: Return one service by id, including its definition and current status. GET /v1/services/{id}.

tools.name: koyeb_get_service_scaling
tools.title: Get service scaling
tools.description: Return the scaling settings of a service (instance count or autoscaling rules). GET /v1/services/{id}/scale.

tools.name: koyeb_pause_service
tools.title: Pause service
tools.description: PAUSE a service: stops its instances, so its public URL stops serving traffic. POST /v1/services/{id}/pause.

tools.name: koyeb_resume_service
tools.title: Resume service
tools.description: RESUME a paused service and start its instances again. skip_build reuses the last image; use_cache reuses build cache. POST /v1/services/{id}/resume.

skip_build.description: Skip the build and reuse the last successful image.

tools.name: koyeb_redeploy_service
tools.title: Redeploy service
tools.description: REDEPLOY a service: starts a new deployment, optionally from a git commit (sha) or to a deployment group. Replaces running instances when it succeeds. POST /v1/services/{id}/redeploy.

sha.description: Git commit to deploy. Empty means the current source.

deployment_group.description: Deployment group to target (for example prod or staging).

skip_build.description: Skip the build and reuse the last successful image.

tools.name: koyeb_list_deployments
tools.title: List deployments
tools.description: List deployments (builds and rollouts) for an app or a service, newest first with status. GET /v1/deployments.

statuses.description: Filter by one or more deployment statuses.

tools.name: koyeb_get_deployment
tools.title: Get deployment
tools.description: Return one deployment by id, with its status and definition. GET /v1/deployments/{id}.

tools.name: koyeb_cancel_deployment
tools.title: Cancel deployment
tools.description: CANCEL a deployment that is still building or rolling out. POST /v1/deployments/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: koyeb_list_instances
tools.title: List instances
tools.description: List running instances (replicas) with status, region and start time. GET /v1/instances.

statuses.description: Filter by one or more instance statuses.

tools.name: koyeb_get_instance
tools.title: Get instance
tools.description: Return one instance by id. GET /v1/instances/{id}.

tools.name: koyeb_query_logs
tools.title: Query logs
tools.description: Read stored logs for an app, service, deployment or instance, filtered by time, stream, text or regex. Use it to find errors. GET /v1/streams/logs/query.

type.description: Log type, as the API defines it (for example build or runtime).

text.description: Only lines that contain this text.

regex.description: Only lines that match this regular expression.

start.description: Start of the window, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

end.description: End of the window, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

tools.name: koyeb_get_metrics
tools.title: Get metrics
tools.description: Return one metric time series (CPU, memory, HTTP response time and throughput, public data transfer) for a service or an instance. GET /v1/streams/metrics.

start.description: Start of the window, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

end.description: End of the window, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z).

step.description: Resolution, for example 1m or 1h, as the API accepts it.

tools.name: koyeb_list_domains
tools.title: List domains
tools.description: List custom and Koyeb-provided domains, with their status and the app they point to. GET /v1/domains.

app_ids.description: Filter by one or more app ids.

statuses.description: Filter by one or more domain statuses.

types.description: Filter by one or more domain types.

tools.name: koyeb_get_domain
tools.title: Get domain
tools.description: Return one domain by id, including its verification status. GET /v1/domains/{id}.

tools.name: koyeb_list_volumes
tools.title: List volumes
tools.description: List persistent volumes, with their region and the service they attach to. GET /v1/volumes.

tools.name: koyeb_get_volume
tools.title: Get volume
tools.description: Return one persistent volume by id. GET /v1/volumes/{id}.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Koyeb
prompts.description: What you can do with Koyeb here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_failing_services_and_their_errors
prompts.title: Find failing services and their errors
prompts.description: List the services of an app with their status and recent activity. Query the stored logs of a failing service to find the errors.

prompts.name: check_cpu_memory_and_traffic_of_a_service
prompts.title: Check CPU, memory and traffic of a service
prompts.description: Read a metric time series for a service or an instance, such as CPU, memory or response time. Compare it with the scaling settings of the service.

prompts.name: redeploy_a_service_from_a_commit
prompts.title: Redeploy a service from a commit
prompts.description: Start a new deployment of a service, optionally from a git commit. Read the deployment status, or cancel it while it still builds or rolls out.

prompts.name: pause_and_resume_an_app_or_a_service
prompts.title: Pause and resume an app or a service
prompts.description: Pause an app or a service to stop its public URLs from serving traffic. Resume it later to start its instances again.

prompts.name: review_domains_and_persistent_volumes
prompts.title: Review domains and persistent volumes
prompts.description: List the custom and Koyeb domains with their verification status. List the persistent volumes and the services they attach to.
